chapters.label: The dribble, live
chapters.text: Bilbao, the 2024 Champions League final, six minutes in. Barcelona break against Lyon. Caroline Graham Hansen carries the ball down the right wing, runs at the full-back, dances into the box and sets up Salma Paralluelo. Endler saves!

chapters.label: Slow down
chapters.text: Watch again. She slows right down, almost stopping. The defender leans in to win the ball.

chapters.label: Then burst
chapters.text: Then one quick touch, and a burst of speed. She is gone, into the box!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Slow down to tempt the defender, then burst past with a quick touch.
